title: Early Medieval India
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: 🛡️ Early Medieval India
blocks.intro: An era of regional fragmentation marked by the Tripartite Struggle and the rise of Rajput kingdoms.

blocks.heading: 1. Tripartite Struggle (8th - 10th CE)
blocks.intro: A century-long struggle between three major empires to control **Kannauj** (symbol of sovereignty in North India, situated in the fertile Gangetic plains):
bullets: The Palas of Bengal: Founded by Gopala. Dharmapala founded **Vikramashila University** and revived Nalanda. Followed Mahayana Buddhism.
The Gurjara-Pratiharas: Ruled Western India/Rajasthan. Mihira Bhoja was the greatest ruler.
The Rashtrakutas: Ruled Deccan. Founded by Dantidurga. **Krishna I** carved the monolithic **Kailash Temple at Ellora (Cave 16)**. Patronised Amoghavarsha (wrote *Kavirajamarga*).

formulas: Vikramashila Univ: Dharmapala | Ellora Kailash Temple: Krishna I (Rashtrakuta)
